body.intent: Fix rhiza apply refuses to write to a change set whose fold has a concurrent-entries warning (ErrConcurrent), though rhiza check only warns on it and single writes (rhiza set/add/link) succeed. scratchOps in internal/api/apply.go returns problems[0] for any fold problem. Repro: change set 01M79KH59D0HEME6B85PXXB056, where entries 01M7AHXPZYKTZVKB02T0NAN2YZ and 01M7AK05HZNK14DCH9GW0ARKYR both write op 01M79KPE0KMZHN6W97EDHJ5H21 (a later entry, 01M7AKMF541ZKACQ21FDF8XVEP, follows both). Any rhiza apply --change on it fails with 'changeset: concurrent entries: ...'. Expected: apply ignores ErrConcurrent as check does.
